changeSet.sql: insert into reporting_package_facts ( tenant_id, package_id, business_record_id, package_type, status, received_at, last_observed_at, document_count, page_count, first_delivered_at, last_delivered_at, successful_export_cycles, reviewed_flag, first_review_created_at, first_review_started_at, first_review_completed_at, active_processing_seconds, reprocess_count, last_reprocessed_at, package_purged_at, created_at, updated_at ) select p.tenant_id, p.id, p.business_record_id, p.package_type, p.status, p.created_at, p.updated_at, (select count(*) from documents d where d.tenant_id=p.tenant_id and d.package_id=p.id), (select coalesce(sum(d.page_count),0) from documents d where d.tenant_id=p.tenant_id and d.package_id=p.id), (select min(e.exported_at) from package_export_records e where e.tenant_id=p.tenant_id and e.package_id=p.id), (select max(e.exported_at) from package_export_records e where e.tenant_id=p.tenant_id and e.package_id=p.id), (select count(*) from package_export_records e where e.tenant_id=p.tenant_id and e.package_id=p.id), exists(select 1 from review_tasks rt where rt.tenant_id=p.tenant_id and rt.package_id=p.id), (select min(rt.created_at) from review_tasks rt where rt.tenant_id=p.tenant_id and rt.package_id=p.id), (select min(a.occurred_at) from audit_records a join review_tasks rt on rt.tenant_id=a.tenant_id and cast(rt.id as text)=a.resource_id where a.tenant_id=p.tenant_id and rt.package_id=p.id and a.resource_type='ReviewTask' and a.action='REVIEW_STARTED'), (select min(a.occurred_at) from audit_records a join review_tasks rt on rt.tenant_id=a.tenant_id and cast(rt.id as text)=a.resource_id where a.tenant_id=p.tenant_id and rt.package_id=p.id and a.resource_type='ReviewTask' and a.action in ('REVIEW_APPROVED','REVIEW_REJECTED')), coalesce(( select sum(extract(epoch from (cycles.completed_at-cycles.started_at))) from ( select a.correlation_id, min(a.occurred_at) filter (where a.action='PACKAGE_PROCESSING_STARTED') started_at, max(a.occurred_at) filter (where a.action='PACKAGE_PROCESSING_COMPLETED') completed_at from audit_records a where a.tenant_id=p.tenant_id and a.resource_type='DocumentPackage' and a.resource_id=cast(p.id as text) and a.action in ('PACKAGE_PROCESSING_STARTED','PACKAGE_PROCESSING_COMPLETED') group by a.correlation_id having count(*) filter (where a.action='PACKAGE_PROCESSING_STARTED') > 0 and count(*) filter (where a.action='PACKAGE_PROCESSING_COMPLETED') > 0 ) cycles where cycles.completed_at >= cycles.started_at ),0), (select count(*) from audit_records a where a.tenant_id=p.tenant_id and a.resource_type='DocumentPackage' and a.resource_id=cast(p.id as text) and a.action='PACKAGE_REPROCESS_REQUESTED'), (select max(a.occurred_at) from audit_records a where a.tenant_id=p.tenant_id and a.resource_type='DocumentPackage' and a.resource_id=cast(p.id as text) and a.action='PACKAGE_REPROCESS_REQUESTED'), (select pl.purged_at from package_lifecycles pl where pl.tenant_id=p.tenant_id and pl.package_id=p.id), now(), now() from document_packages p on conflict (tenant_id, package_id) do nothing;

changeSet.author: securedoc
changeSet.sql:
insert into reporting_package_events (tenant_id,event_id,package_id,event_type,occurred_at,created_at) select a.tenant_id,a.id,cast(a.resource_id as uuid),'REPROCESS_REQUESTED',a.occurred_at,now() from audit_records a where a.resource_type='DocumentPackage' and a.action='PACKAGE_REPROCESS_REQUESTED' on conflict (tenant_id,event_id) do nothing;
insert into reporting_package_events (tenant_id,event_id,package_id,event_type,occurred_at,created_at) select e.tenant_id,e.id,e.package_id,'EXPORT_SUCCEEDED',e.exported_at,now() from package_export_records e on conflict (tenant_id,event_id) do nothing;
